description: Read-only map of this workspace's memories, rules and skills, grouped into regions by links and meaning. view=atlas: the whole system in under 1k tokens. view=region: one region's items, relations and issues, paged (purpose=audit adds a checklist). view=related: what else to read or update with given item_ids, titles, files or a query. Use before a quality pass, before updating knowledge, or to see how things relate. No confirmation needed.

item_ids.description: Memory, rule or skill ids to start from (view=related).

purpose.description: audit appends the audit checklist to region pages.

region_id.description: Region (rg_) or sub-region (sr_) id from the atlas (view=region).

titles.description: Titles or names to start from (view=related).

view.description: atlas: all regions; region: one region's page; related: neighbours of the given seeds.

name: pathrule_knowledge_map

algorithm.description: Map algorithm version; region ids are stable within it.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

related.description: Related entries with ids, reasons and scores (view=related).

retry_after_ms.description: When status is computing, how long to wait before calling again.

status.description: ready, computing (call again after retry_after_ms) or unavailable.

title: Knowledge Map
